project.name: Balatro
project.selectionReason: User-designated acceptance package containing a complete Love runtime, resources, localization, shaders, input, audio and save paths

source.warning: This is a user-supplied licensed local package. Its contents must not be committed, uploaded, or included in Dora-SSR release artifacts.

notes: The probe starts main.lua directly through LoveNode and does not execute the package's Dora init.lua wrapper
The archive contains compatibility changes and is not evidence of unmodified retail Balatro compatibility

flows: boot through main.lua and reach the main menu
start a run and select a blind
select cards, play one hand and discard one hand
open the shop and exercise a shop action when available
verify keyboard, pointer/touch mapping, audio playback and volume control
reload and verify save restoration, then stop and prove Love resources are released
record screenshots, logs, frame progress, page errors and heap/resource trends
